name: NINZ Icons for Elementor
author: Shakil Ansary

sections.description:
NINZ Icons for Elementor adds 1034 Solar SVG icons directly into the Elementor icon picker as a dedicated tab. Icons are sharp, scalable, and fully color-controllable using Elementor’s built-in color controls — no extra configuration needed.

Features:

  • 1034 Solar SVG icons
  • Dedicated tab inside the Elementor icon picker
  • Icons inherit color from Elementor’s color controls
  • CSS mask-image rendering — sharp on all screen sizes and resolutions
  • Zero external API calls, zero tracking, all assets bundled locally
  • Lightweight — only loads icons that are actually used on the page

Credits

This plugin uses Solar Icons by 480 Design.
Source: https://icones.js.org/collection/solar

sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin folder to /wp-content/plugins/
  2. Activate the plugin through the Plugins menu in WordPress
  3. Open the Elementor editor, add an Icon widget, click the icon picker and select the NINZ Icons tab
sections.faq:
Does this require Elementor?

Yes, Elementor must be installed and activated for this plugin to work. It is compatible with both the free and Pro versions of Elementor.

Will this slow down my website?

No. The plugin only loads icon assets when they are actually used on a page. It is significantly lighter than Font Awesome and similar icon font libraries.

Can I control the icon color?

Yes. Icons use CSS mask-image which means they fully inherit color from Elementor’s color picker, just like any other icon widget.

Can I add my own icons?

Not in this version, but custom icon support is planned for a future release.
